content: Existing .std viewers converge on a consistent UX: instant 3D render with real cross-section shapes (OpenBuilding extrudes SectionProfile polygons from AISC db - never generic cylinders), click-to-inspect info panel (section, dims, start/end nodes, group), view modes (solid/wireframe/x-ray), orbit/pan nav modes, responsive layout (desktop floating toolbar, mobile fixed bottom bar), dark mode, fully client-side no account. STAAD.Pro GUI itself offers 3D Sections (Full/Sections Outline/None), color-by attribute (section/material), support icons, load arrows with values, node numbers, local axis indicators (X blue Y red Z green), color legend. Mobile field viewers (Bentley Structural Navigator, SAP2000 Cloud Viewer) emphasize: zoom/rotate/pan/walkthrough, color-code by property, filter by attribute, tap-to-query all property values, measure distances, view-only review workflow for site visits. Engineers expect: see the structure immediately framed, distinguish member types by color, identify supports/loads at a glance, tap any member for its properties.
